strings.(분주하게 날아다니던 작은 새들이 집과 집 사이에 걸려 있던 빨랫줄에 앉: (Little birds settle on the washing lines strung between houses and chirp as though announcing the morning.)
strings.(여관 앞으로 나온 나르샤가 새들을 바라보다가 작은 입으로 하품한다.): (Outside the inn, Narsha watches them and gives a small yawn.)
Doing nothing but resting makes my whole body feel stiff. Yaaawn.
strings.(기지개를 키던 나르샤가 인기척을 느끼곤 뒤돌아본다.): (Stretching, Narsha senses someone approaching and turns.)
I barely managed to fall asleep.
strings.폐하께서 편의를 봐주신 건 정말 정말 감사하게 생각해요. 그런데, 제가: I'm very, very grateful for Her Majesty's kindness. But I keep wondering if I deserve all this.
strings.라슈에트 여관에 있는 침대를 모두 고급품으로 바꿔주시고, 황성에서나 먹을: She replaced every bed in the LaChouette inn with a luxurious one, provided treats you'd expect only at the palace...
strings.거기에 기사 분들께서 여관 근처를 비롯한 라슈에트 거리에 잔뜩 상주하고: And there are knights stationed all around the inn and the streets...
strings.나르샤, 집으로 돌아가고 싶은 마음은 알겠지만, 조금만 참아요. 폐하께서: I know you do, Narsha. Just hold on a little longer. Her Majesty asked us to wait.
I've never stayed in Glaston this long before. Perhaps that's why.
strings.저기…, 레이븐 님이 무슨 나쁜 일이라도 저지른 걸까요?: Um... Has Raven done something bad?
strings.기사단이 쫓고 있다는 걸 보면 보통 일은 아닐 것 같다는 생각이 들어서요: If the knights are looking for him, it must be serious.
strings.(나르샤의 머리 위로 태양을 삼킨 듯한 커다란 그림자가 드리운다.): (A great shadow falls over Narsha, as though swallowing the sun.)
strings.두 분, 잘 쉬고 계셨습니까?: Have you both been resting well?
strings.어서 오세요, 아르젠트. 저희는 폐하께서 많이 배려해 주신 덕분에 잘 쉬: Welcome, Argent. We have, thanks to Her Majesty's care.
strings.나르샤 양, 내일 폐하의 명을 받아 플라티나라는 성기사가 찾아올 것입니다: Narsha, a paladin called Platina will come tomorrow on Her Majesty's orders.
strings.그에게 호위를 맡겼으니 함께 돌아가시면 됩니다. 아, 카드도 그가 들고: He will escort you home. He'll bring your card, too, so be sure to ask him for it.
Oh, my card... Thank you, Argent.
We will explain everything concerning the Bureau mage Raven when the time comes.
strings.(그 마법사를 쫓는 일이 길어지는 걸까?): (Is finding him taking longer than expected?)
There's somewhere I'd like you to come with me.
Oh... Of course. I'll get ready.
strings.(모험가가 여관으로 들어가 짐을 챙길 동안, 가만히 밖에서 서있던 나르샤: (While the adventurer goes inside to gather their belongings, Narsha and Argent meet each other's eyes.)
strings.모험가님과 가실 곳이라는 게 위험한 장소인가요?: Is the place you're taking the adventurer dangerous?
strings.아닙니다. 폐하의 말씀을 전하기 위해 함께 가는 것뿐입니다. 다 괜찮을: No. We are only going together so I can relay Her Majesty's message. She said everything would be all right. You needn't worry.
That's a relief. I thought it might be somewhere dangerous again...
strings.(나르샤가 마침 나온 모험가를 발견하고는 말을 아낀다.): (Narsha falls quiet as the adventurer returns.)
I don't know when I'll be back, so I'll say goodbye now.
strings.괜찮아요, %s 님. 함께 글래스턴에 와서 즐거웠어요. 그러면 나중에 봐: It's all right, %s. I enjoyed coming to Glaston with you. See you again. Take care, too, Argent.
strings.(나르샤가 아르젠트와 %s에게 인사하고 다시 여관으로 들어간다.): (Narsha bids Argent and %s farewell, then returns to the inn.)
strings.(아르젠트를 따라 광장에 있는 카페 옆에 있는 길에 도착한다. 오는 동안: (Argent leads the way to a street beside a café in the square. Along the way, residents greet him or look at him with admiration.)
This way. This street leads to the administrative district.
strings.국가의 일을 하는 관청들이 있는 구역입니다. 제국의 관청에 대해 말씀드리: Where the government offices handle affairs of state. Explaining them all would take forever, but one you would recognize, %s...
strings.그렇습니다. 마법청 관련 이야기는 천천히 하기로 하고, 소개해 드릴 친구: Correct. We can discuss the Bureau shortly. First, there's a friend I'd like to introduce.
Not Silvia. Forgive me, but why did you think I meant her... ?
strings.(실비아가 북쪽 거리에서 광장으로 오고 있다가 아르젠트를 발견하고는 발걸: (Silvia, walking from the northern street toward the square, spots Argent and stops.)
...Haah. Running into Argent during my precious break...
strings.(실비아를 발견한 아르젠트의 표정이 굳는다.): (Argent's expression stiffens at the sight of Silvia.)
I believe you're supposed to be working now.
strings.내가 일도 안 하고 쉬고 있을까 봐? 그러는 오빠 너는 왜 여기 있는 건: Do you think I'm slacking off? What are you doing here, anyway? Surely you didn't come just to lecture me.
I have business with %s in the administrative district... I won't explain at length. Satisfied?
Really? Then carry on and leave me be.
strings.기록원에도 휴게실이 있는 걸로 알고 있는데, 굳이 광장까지 와서 쉬는 이: The Archives has a break room. Why come all the way to the square... ?
strings.어르신들밖에 없던 사무실에 내가 막내로 들어가서 딱 하나 뿐인 휴게실 자: Everyone in the office is older than me. As the youngest, I feel awkward taking over the only break room.
They said I could step outside for a while, so here I am.
I understand. Take a short break, then return. And here...
strings.(아르젠트가 실비아의 손을 붙잡고는 품 안에서 꺼낸 금화 여러 개를 쥐여: (Argent takes Silvia's hand and presses several gold coins into it.)
strings.입 심심한 거 못 참잖아. 간식 같은 거 사서 들어가. 어르신들 것도 좀: You can never go long without a snack. Buy something before you return. Something for your colleagues, too.
Try obeying me at other times, too.
See you later, %s. You too, big brother. Work hard.
strings.(아르젠트를 따라 광장 북쪽 거리로 올라가던 %s의 시야에 멀리 다른 구: (Following Argent up the street north of the square, %s sees another district in the distance.)
You called this the northern street? It seems rather quiet.
The morning commute has already passed.
Let me get to the point. Her Majesty sent a message.
strings.폐하께서 곧 의회의 귀족들을 압박할 예정이라고 하셨습니다. 그리고 한 가: She intends to put pressure on the council's nobles soon. And she has a request.
strings.얼마 전 일이 해결되면서 글래스턴을 흔들던 마력이 잠시 멈췄는데, 그 사: When the recent incident was resolved, the magic shaking Glaston briefly stopped. Raven disappeared during that interval.
It seems likely to be connected...
strings.레이븐이라는 마법사…, 정체가 뭐죠?: Who exactly is this mage Raven?
strings.정확한 건 아닙니다만…, 레이븐이 마법청에서 하는 온갖 나쁜 일의 중심에: We don't know every detail, but he was at the center of the Bureau's wrongdoing.
strings.노네임과 아탈란테를 통해 마신을 깨우려고 했고, 다른 방법으로 나르샤를: He tried to awaken a demon god through No Name and Atalante, and planned to use Narsha by another method.
Exactly. Find evidence of Raven's actions.
strings.시간이 좀 지났는데, 그동안 증거를 다 없애진 않았을까요?: It's been a while. Couldn't he have destroyed the evidence by now?
strings.폐하께서 말씀하시길 레이븐이 손대지 못한 것이 있을 거라고 하십니다. 그: Her Majesty says something remains beyond Raven's reach. We need information about that object.
Perhaps something ordinary humans cannot find or handle.
Of course. I'll inform Her Majesty.
strings.아, 맞다. 소개해 주시겠다는 분은 어디에 있죠?: Oh, where's the person you wanted to introduce?
strings.(아르젠트가 멀리서 주위 풍경을 구경하고 있는 한 소녀를 가리킨다.): (Argent points to a girl in the distance, looking around.)
(The girl turns from the administrative district as she notices them.)
strings.넹. 그동안 행정 지구에서 큰일 없었어여. 사소한 것까지 보고하라 하셨으: Okay! Nothing major has happened in the administrative district. You said to report even little things, so here goes.
The Magic Bureau building isn't shaking anymore.
strings.마법사들 말로는 마법청에 마법 도구가 많아서 마력이 서로 부딪친대여. 그: The mages say all the magical tools inside cause their magic to collide. The aftershocks make the building shake now and then.
Around when Her Majesty visited LaChouette recently, I think.
strings.(아르젠트에게 행정 지구의 상황을 보고한 소녀가 환하게 웃으며 손을 흔든: (After reporting to Argent, the girl smiles brightly and waves.)
Hello! I'm Leticia, a knight. You can call me Letty.
A knight? I wouldn't have guessed.
I am, hehe. Not a regular knight, though. A free knight.
strings.원래 견습 기사였었는데, 테러나이트처럼 될 수 있다는 말에 홀라당 속아: I used to be a squire. Then I fell for a promise that I could become like a Terror Knight and helped with the Bureau's research. Something went wrong, and I had to leave.
strings.복장 때문에 기사 아닌 줄 아셨구나. 단장님께서 본분을 지키는 선에서 아: My clothes threw you off, didn't they? The Commander said I could wear whatever I liked, as long as I did my duty.
I'm sorry... I should have stopped it...
strings.단장님이 뭐가 미안해여? 저는 괜찮아여. 몸이 아프고 그런 것도 아니잖아: What are you sorry for, Commander? I'm fine. I'm not sick or anything.
And I got telekinesis, just like that! I like it. It's cool, like a Terror Knight.
That's not what a Terror Knight...
strings.넹. 염력이여. 정신을 집중하면 작은 물건 같은 걸 띄울 수 있어여. 잠: Yep! If I concentrate, I can lift small objects. Watch my hand.
strings.(레티시아가 손끝으로 바닥에 떨어진 작은 돌을 가리킨다. 잠시 후, 돌이: (Leticia points at a small stone on the ground. After a moment, it rises and follows her gestures.)
strings.할 말을 잃으신 거 보니까 많이 놀라셨나 봐여? 저도 어느 순간부터 쓸: Speechless? You must be surprised! So was I when I suddenly found I could do it. Hehe.
Letty, I told you not to show that so freely...
...Everyone in Glaston knows. Silvia said it was cool, too.
Her Majesty did say to leave it alone, but already...
Whatever kind of ability it is, I want to use it well and do something wonderful. Like you, Commander.
strings.(레티시아가 미간을 잔뜩 찌푸리는 아르젠트의 표정을 확인하고는 그제야 물: (Seeing Argent's deep frown, Leticia finally steps back.)
I'd like to hear more about the Bureau's research...
strings.레티에게 더 물어보셔도 정확한 답은 듣지 못하실 겁니다. 연구 과정의 기: Letty won't be able to give you a clear answer. Every memory of the research process is gone.
Then I suppose there's nothing we can do.
strings.%s 님께 레티를 소개해 드리려고 왔다. 나중에 레티가 %s 님을 도울: I came to introduce you to %s. I expect there will be a task where you can help %s later.
Oh, an escort mission? I've always wanted to try one.
A kind of escort duty... That may be the simplest way to think of it.
Understood, Commander. I'll guard %s with everything I've got!
Sorry, I should have done that sooner. I'm...
Wow, you're amazing! I had no idea who I was meeting.
It's all right. I'm glad to have your help, Letty.
I'm glad to work with you, too.
strings.저 부탁이 하나 있어여. 이렇게 대단하신 분이면 황실에서 인증한 카드 있: Can I ask a favor? Someone as impressive as you must have an imperial authorization card, right? Could I see it?
strings.우와아, 진짜다. 진짜 처음 봐여. 이거면 지나가던 병사들도 꼼짝 못 할: Wow, it's real! I've never seen one before. With that, even passing soldiers won't dare bother you.
strings.%s 님께서도 아시겠지만, 그 카드의 소유자는 황실의 인정을 받아서 이에: As you know, %s, the card marks the imperial family's recognition and grants its holder corresponding privileges.
strings.최근에 주의를 크게 줬으니 일반 병사들이 함부로 대할 일은 없을 것입니다: The soldiers have recently received a firm warning. They should not treat you disrespectfully.
strings.레티. 이제 순찰할 시간이지?: Letty. Isn't it time for your patrol?
strings.아, 맞당. 시간이 벌써 이렇게 됐네여. 저는 이만, 행정 지구 돌아보러: Oh, right! Look at the time. I'd better check the administrative district.
strings.(레티시아가 아르젠트와 %s에게 인사하고는 곧바로 행정 지구 쪽을 향해: (Leticia says goodbye to Argent and %s, then runs straight toward the administrative district.)
Despite appearances, she's a skilled knight.
If you say so, Argent, I believe it.
strings.다시 글래스턴에 돌아오신다면 바로 레티시아를 찾으시면 됩니다. 행정 지구: When you return to Glaston, find Leticia directly. She knows everything happening in the administrative district.
I see. I'll make a brief visit to the Sanctuary.
Ah, that's why you asked for time... Understood. Until then.
strings.(언제나 하얀 빛과 꽃으로 모험가를 맞이했던 공간이 조금은 쓸쓸한 느낌으: (The space that always welcomed the adventurer with white light and flowers feels a little lonely.)
strings.(그런 공간 가운데 이리스가 눈을 감은 채 서있다.): (Iris stands at its center, eyes closed.)
strings.어? %s…. 언제 왔어요?: Oh? %s... When did you get here?
I didn't sense you coming. You startled me. Oh, there's something I want to tell you, %s.
strings.얼마 전까지 두렵고 무서운 기분이 들었는데, 위대한 벽 너머에서 희망이: Until recently, I felt frightened and uneasy. But I saw hope beyond the Great Wall. A little longer, and things will get better.
It's because you're doing well, Iris.
I have to keep going a little longer.
Why don't you rest for a moment? You've done so much. You look tired.
strings.아시다시피 제가 쉴 수는 없어요. 잠깐 쉬는 동안, 손 쓸 수 없는 일이: You know I can't rest. If something beyond our control happened while I stopped...
If it's Hecate's visit that's worrying you...
No. Hecate must sense my resolve, too.
After Hecate visited, I remembered my grandmother.
At some point, I seem to have forgotten her. My grandmother, who passed away.
strings.세상에 둘도 없는 가족이고, 너무나 소중한 사람인 할머니를 잊고 있었다니: My only family. Someone so precious to me. How could I have forgotten her...?
I couldn't recall her, as though part of my memory had been erased...
strings.거의 다 생각나요. 다만, 할머니가 어떻게 돌아가셨는지는…. 그것만 떠오: Almost. But how she died... That's the only thing I can't remember.
As though someone is preventing me from recalling it...
strings.(이리스가 뭔가 깨달은 것 같은 표정을 짓는다. 그리고 살며시 기지개를: (As though realizing something, Iris gives a gentle stretch.)
strings.진작 이야기할 걸 그랬나 봐요. 괜히 마음에 담아두고 있어서 답답했던 거: I should have told you sooner. Keeping it to myself was weighing on me. I promised not to hide things from you...
strings.네…. 아, 맞다. 폐하께서 부탁하신 일을 이야기하러 온 거죠?: Yes... Oh, that's right. You came about Her Majesty's request?
strings.응, 맞아. 어, 그러면 이제 글래스턴의 이야기가 들려오는 거야?: Yes. Wait, you can hear what's happening in Glaston now?
With the spirits' help, I can learn quite a bit, apart from certain areas.
Exactly. If there's anything I can help with, tell me.
strings.고마워, 이리스. 당장은 없을 것 같지만, 만약에 그런 일이 생긴다면 이: Thank you, Iris. Nothing right now, but if something comes up, I'll ask.
strings.네…. 지금 컨디션은 어때요?: All right... How are you feeling?
I've rested, but I'm not sure.
Would you like to stay a little longer? You'll recover soon.
strings.(모험가는 신탁의 방에서 잠시 휴식 시간을 가지고, 이리스의 도움을 받아: (The adventurer rests for a while in the Oracle Chamber, then returns to Glaston with Iris's help.)
Everyone, get to the square! Evacuate, quickly! Cough, cough.
strings.어르신과 아이부터 빨리 저쪽으로, 광장으로 가세요!!: Elderly people and children first! That way, to the square!
strings.(흙먼지가 자욱해서 앞이 보이지 않는 거리에서 많은 사람들의 목소리가 들: (Voices rise through streets so thick with dust that nothing can be seen.)
strings.(먼지 사이로 광장 북쪽 거리의 모습이 조금씩 나타난다.): (Through the dust, the street north of the square gradually emerges.)
Huh? Am I here? What's with all this dust?
strings.여기서 멍하니 있지 마시고 빨리 피하세요!! 광장으로 가세요!! 쿨럭,: Don't stand there! Get out! Head to the square! Cough, cough.
strings.(상황을 살펴보기 위해 앞으로 가는 동안, 다시 커다란 먼지가 소용돌이처: (As the adventurer moves forward to investigate, another great cloud of dust swirls up. An inhuman shadow emerges.)
strings.(사람들을 향해 공격할 것처럼 달려오던 존재는 이내 모험가의 발 밑으로: (The creature rushes toward the fleeing people, then crashes down at the adventurer's feet.)
strings.(바닥에 떨어진 건, 마법서들이 뭉쳐져 만들어진 일종의 골렘 같은 괴물이: (The fallen creature resembles a golem formed from a mass of spellbooks.)
strings.(누군가 쓰러진 괴물의 모습을 보고는 안도의 한숨을 내쉰다.): (Someone sighs in relief at the fallen monster.)
strings.순찰 중에 마법청사에서 갑자기 몬스터들이 나타난 거에여! 그래서 단장님께: Monsters suddenly came out of the Magic Bureau while I was patrolling! I reported to the Commander and called the knights. We're evacuating everyone!
strings.전 괜찮아여! 빨리 몬스터들을 막아야 해여!: I'm fine! We have to stop the monsters!
strings.(정말 괜찮아 보이네? 대피하던 사람들은 계속 기침하고 그러던데….): (She really does seem fine. Everyone evacuating keeps coughing...)
strings.(주위를 살펴보고 있던 그때, 커다란 건틀렛으로 무장한 기사들이 나타나: (As the adventurer looks around, knights armed with huge gauntlets fill the street.)
Letty, has everyone over there been evacuated? Cough, cough.
strings.이쪽은 기사들이 모두 확인했지만, 혹시 모르니 더 들어가서 확인…. 어,: The knights have checked this side, but go farther in, just in case... Oh, %s? You're here?
I'm glad you're safe. Let me explain the situation.
strings.마법청사에서 일종의 독기(毒氣)가 먼지 형태로 퍼지고 있습니다. 그리고: A kind of noxious vapor is spreading from the Magic Bureau in the form of dust. Monsters drawn to it have appeared in the streets.
strings.독기는 크게 위험하진 않지만, 이 몬스터들이 광장이나 황성 쪽으로 갈 수: The vapor isn't highly dangerous, but the monsters could reach the square or palace. The knights are moving into the administrative district to contain them.
Yes. This seems to be the moment.
strings.(아르젠트가 알겠다는 듯 고개를 끄덕인다. 그리고 시선을 레티에게 옮긴다: (Argent nods, then turns his gaze to Letty.)
strings.서둘러 %s 님을 모시고 마법청사로 향해라. 혹시라도 대피하지 못한 사람: Escort %s to the Magic Bureau immediately. If you find anyone who hasn't evacuated, direct them to safety.
Got it! I mean, understood, Commander.
strings.(아르젠트가 들고 있던 헬멧을 쓰자마자 어딘가로 달려간다. 그러자 대기하: (Argent puts on the helmet in his hand and runs off. The waiting knights follow him.)
If they've deployed that many knights, there must be a lot of monsters.
There are! I've already taken down dozens myself.
strings.(실력이 훌륭한 기사라고 했는데, 정말일까?): (He said she was a skilled knight. Is she really that good?)
strings.%s 님, 안 가세여? 이대로 있다가는 마법청사 근처에도 못 가여! 제가: Aren't you coming, %s? At this rate, we won't even get near the Bureau! I'll guide you. Hurry!
strings.(행정 지구에 발을 내디딘 순간부터 몬스터들이 나타나 두 사람을 방해한다: (From the moment they enter the administrative district, monsters block their path.)
strings.(수에서만 밀릴 뿐, 몬스터는 그다지 강하지 않았기 때문에 두 사람 앞에: (The creatures have numbers on their side, but little strength. They fall helplessly before the pair.)
strings.와, %s 님. 대단해여. 이 많은 몬스터들을 한 번에 짜잔- 하고 해치: Wow, %s! Amazing! You took out all those monsters at once. Just like that!
Hehe. Thank you! Follow this road, and we'll reach the Magic Bureau.
strings.어, %s 님, 저기 누가 있어여. 마법청 마법사 같은데, 지친 기색이: Oh, %s, someone's over there. He looks like a Bureau mage. So exhausted... Maybe he's been working for days without going home.
strings.(레티시아가 가리킨 곳에는 언젠가 한 번 봤었던 마법사가 어딘가로 가고: (Where Leticia points, a familiar mage walks away: disheveled hair, large glasses, and a spellbook held against his chest.)
strings.(레티시아의 목소리를 들은 레이븐이 뒤를 돌아본다. 그러다 모험가가 있다: (At Leticia's call, Raven turns. Spotting the adventurer, he breaks into a run.)
strings.마법사님! 마법사 아저씨! 어디 가여?! 돌아와여!!: Mister Mage! Where are you going? Come back!
Where do I start? It's complicated...
strings.잘은 모르겠지만, 이 일에 마법청 마법사들이 관련된 거 맞져?: I don't know the details, but the Bureau's mages are involved in this, right?
strings.마법청사 주변에서 이런 일이 일어나고 있는데, 마법청 마법사들이 하나도: All this is happening around their headquarters, but not one of them has appeared. They aren't evacuating, either. What are they doing?
strings.레티, 마법청사가 어디에 있어요?: Letty, where is the Magic Bureau?
strings.마법청사는 행정 지구 들어서면 보이는 제일 높은 곳에 있어여. 여기선 안: At the highest point you can see when you enter the administrative district. You can't see it from here... Oh, the dust cleared.
I know a shortcut. Follow me.
We're here, %s. This is the Magic Bureau.
(The white building is smaller than the other government offices and radiates an ominous atmosphere. Something inside makes it tremble.)
strings.(레티시아가 마법청사 건물로 다가가려는 순간, 어디선가 새 울음소리가 크: (As Leticia approaches the building, a loud birdcall rings out.)
strings.(마법사 모자를 착용한 부엉이 한 마리가 날아오더니 레티시아 앞으로 떨어: (An owl wearing a wizard's hat flies over and drops in front of Leticia.)
strings.(레티시아가 쓰러진 부엉이를 두 손으로 붙잡고 일으킨다. 부엉이가 레티시: (Leticia lifts the fallen owl with both hands. Recognizing her, it bursts into cries.)
strings.피카부, 오늘 쉬는 날이잖아여. 대체 무슨 일이 일어난 거예여?: Peekaboo, isn't this your day off? What happened?
strings.레티, 이 부엉이가 뭐라고 해요?: What is the owl saying, Letty?
I don't know. Humans can't understand owls, can they?
Peekaboo, we're going into the Magic Bureau.
strings.(부엉이가 레티시아의 말을 듣더니 놀라서 앞으로 날아와 막는다.): (Alarmed, the owl flies in front of her and blocks the way.)
strings.%s 님, 피카부가 우리보고 들어가지 말라고 하는 것 같아여. 무슨 일이: %s, I think Peekaboo is telling us not to go inside. Something has definitely happened...
strings.레티, 이 부엉이가 어느 정도 사람 말을 알아듣는 거 맞죠?: Letty, this owl understands human speech to some extent, right?
strings.넹, 피카부는 똑똑한 데다가 마력도 다뤄서 옛날부터 마법청 마법사들이 데: Yes. Peekaboo is clever and can use magic, so the Bureau's mages have kept him for years.
strings.마법도 잘 쓰고, 심부름도 잘해서 사람들에게 인기가 많아여. 아이들도 좋: He's good at magic and errands. Everyone loves him, especially the children.
strings.(피카부가 맞다는 것처럼 날갯짓을 한다. 그리고는 마법청사를 가리키며 날: (Peekaboo flaps as though agreeing, then points at the Bureau and crosses his wings into an X.)
strings.이대로 들어가면 안 되는 건가? 아, 어디 부엉이 말 알아듣는 사람 없나: So we can't go in like this? Is there anyone who understands owls?
strings.(그런 그때, 어디선가 들어본 새의 지저귐과 함께 마법청사 위에 크고 짙: (A familiar chirp sounds, and a huge, dark shadow falls over the Magic Bureau.)
strings.으아아, 저게 뭐져? 떠, 떨어져여!: Aaaaah! What is that? It's f-falling!
strings.(허공에 있던 커다랗고 파란 뭔가가 그대로 두 사람을 향해 떨어지지만,: (Something huge and blue drops toward them, but the sound it makes is not what they expected.)
Wow! The fat bird shrank and landed on %s's head!
strings.실피드 님? 여긴 어떻게 오신 거예요?: Sylphid? How did you get here?
Chirp-chirp. I flew. And you, little one. I'm not fat.
strings.찌르. 피카부가 그러는데, 저 건물 안에서 마력이 폭주하고 있대. 창고: Chirp. Peekaboo says the magic inside that building is running wild. Something in the storeroom... What?
strings.찌르, 금서의 봉인이 풀렸는데, 어떻게 풀렸는지는 피카부도 모른대. 안에: Chirp. The forbidden books have been unsealed. Peekaboo doesn't know how. He's asking us to save his friends inside...
strings.찌르르. 에구. 지금 이 상태로는 아무도 못 들어가. 금서에서 터져 나오: Chirp-chirp. Oh dear. No one can enter like this. The magic pouring from those books doesn't belong to our world.
strings.찌르. %s, 설명하자면 길어. 일단 내가 힘 좀 쓸 테니까 근처에 있는: Chirp. It's a long explanation, %s. I'll work on this. Deal with the nasty creatures nearby.
Chirp-chirp. Meanwhile, Peekaboo and I will disperse some of this magic.
strings.찌르. 피카부, 잘 들어. 지금 날개 하나, 부리 하나가 모자랄 판인데: Chirp. Listen, Peekaboo. We need every wing and beak we can get. You can't stand around, can you?
Chirp-chirp. No time for lectures. Hurry, %s.
strings.그러면 실피드 님, 부탁드릴게요. 레티, 들었죠?: I'll leave it to you, Sylphid. You heard him, Letty?
strings.자세한 건 나중에 이야기할게요. 일단 실피드 님이 하라는 대로 주위에 몬: I'll explain later. For now, do as Sylphid says and keep the monsters away.
strings.넹. 제대로 오지 못하게 할게여!: Got it. They won't get anywhere near!
strings.찌르르. 그래, 그렇게 하는 거야. 자, 해보자고!: Chirp-chirp. That's the spirit. Let's do this!
strings.(실피드가 피카부와 함께 마법청사 건물 위로 날아오른다. 그리고 짧은 날: (Sylphid flies above the Magic Bureau with Peekaboo and beats his short wings vigorously.)
strings.(강한 마력을 품은 바람이 불어와 마법청사로 다가온 순간, 흔들리고 있던: (A wind charged with powerful magic reaches the Bureau, and the trembling building becomes still.)
strings.찌르. 이 정도면 괜찮겠지. 피카부. 가서 애들 불러와. 잠깐…. 잠깐만: Chirp. That should do. Peekaboo, fetch the others. Wait... Hold on. Do you know who that is?
strings.(마법청사를 향해 다가오던 마법사가 고개를 들어 하늘을 바라본다.): (The mage approaching the Bureau looks up at the sky.)
I wondered who could disperse those magical currents so skillfully. A Spirit King, of course.
strings.(레이븐이 자신의 앞으로 날아온 실피드를 보고는 희미한 미소를 보인다.): (Raven gives a faint smile as Sylphid flies down before him.)
If only we'd met a little sooner. What a shame.
You would have made excellent material for Demiurgos...
strings.(그 말의 뜻을 알고 있던 실피드가 미간을 잔뜩 찌푸리며 작은 날개를 뻗: (Understanding his meaning, Sylphid frowns deeply and extends a small wing.)
strings.(그러자 어딘가에서 회오리 형태의 구름이 몰려오기 시작한다.): (Spiraling clouds begin to gather from somewhere.)
I have important work. No time to waste on a mere spirit...
strings.(레이븐의 얼굴에 그림자가 드리운다. 잠시 후, 마법서가 반으로 펼쳐지면: (A shadow falls over Raven's face. His spellbook opens, and several black arms reach from its pages.)
strings.(실피드가 검은 팔들을 피해 날아다니지만, 어느새 발목을 붙잡힌다.): (Sylphid flies to avoid them, but one catches his ankle.)
I won't destroy you. Bear with it for now. I haven't time to study you...
strings.(레이븐이 가볍게 웃고는 서둘러 마법청사 안으로 들어간다. 잠시 후, 검: (Raven chuckles and hurries inside the Bureau. The black arms spread into a great dark veil, threatening to swallow Sylphid.)
strings.(모험가가 서둘러 검은 장막을 찢고 그 안에서 실피드를 꺼낸다.): (The adventurer tears open the dark veil and pulls Sylphid free.)
strings.(실피드가 %s의 머리를 밟고 올라가 마법청사를 바라본다.): (Sylphid climbs onto %s's head and looks toward the Bureau.)
strings.찌르르. 마신을 언급한 마법사가 안으로 들어가면서 안에 있던 마력이 더: Chirp-chirp. Since that mage who mentioned the demon god went inside, the magic has grown much more violent.
strings.설마 마력이 그 마법사 아저씨한테 반응한다는 거예여?: So the magic is reacting to him?
strings.찌르르. 원래 마법청 안으로 들어가려고 했지? 그리고 그 마법사도 찾으려: Chirp-chirp. You were planning to enter the Bureau, weren't you? And find that mage?
strings.찌르. 그러면 서둘러서 안으로 들어가. 내가 정령들 불러다 안에 있는 마: Chirp. Then hurry inside. I'll call the spirits and keep the magic from escaping.
Chirp-chirp. And you, little one. Look after %s.
strings.우와, 파랑새님. 정령이었어여?: Wow, Mister Bluebird. You're a spirit?
strings.지금은 작지만, 아까 엄청 컸었잖아여. 왕이라서 큰 거였나여?: You're small now, but you were huge before. Were you so big because you're a king?
Chirp-chirp. Exactly. A king-sized king! No, that's not important. Get going!
strings.실피드 님, 그러면 부탁드릴게요. 레티는 괜찮겠어요? 위험할 수도 있어요: We'll leave it to you, Sylphid. Are you sure you're up for this, Letty? It could be dangerous.
strings.저는 주민을 지키고 임무를 수행하는 기사예여! 눈앞에 벌어진 상황을 모른: I'm a knight. I protect the people and carry out my duties! I can't turn my back on what's happening right in front of me!
Phew. All right. Follow me carefully.
strings.(모험가와 레티시아가 마력으로 흔들리고 있는 마법청사로 들어가기 위해 발: (The adventurer and Leticia head into the Magic Bureau, shaking under the force of magic.)
Chirp. What an unusual human child... Now, Peekaboo.
strings.찌르르. 친구들 구해야지. 자, 아까 했던 거 다시 열심히 해보자!: Chirp-chirp. Let's save your friends. Just like before. Give it everything you've got!
strings.(두 사람이 조심스레 안으로 들어갔을 때 보이는 마법청사의 모습은 일반적: (As they cautiously enter, the Bureau's interior feels utterly alien, unlike any ordinary government office.)
strings.(레티시아가 지금 보이는 것을 믿지 못하는지 재차 눈을 비빈다.): (Unable to believe her eyes, Leticia rubs them repeatedly.)
strings.(로비로 보이는 공간이 일그러지고 뒤틀려 있다. 그 위로 마법서와 마법: (What appears to be the lobby is twisted and warped. Spellbooks and magical tools float overhead.)
strings.(그리고 실피드를 삼키려고 했던 검은 장막 같은 그림자가 바닥에서 불꽃처: (On the floor, shadows like the dark veil that tried to swallow Sylphid flicker like flames.)
strings.(시간과 공간이 뒤틀려 있는 것 같아…. 게다가 여기서 느껴지는 건….): (Time and space seem distorted... And the power I feel here...)
strings.(위층으로 가는 평범했었을 계단이 뒤틀린 채로 끝없이 펼쳐지고 있다. 그: (A staircase that once led upstairs stretches endlessly, twisted out of shape. Far along it, Raven wanders, unsure of the way.)
The wall with the bookcase and grandfather clock is halfway between the third and fourth floors, on the left.
strings.어? 레티, 그걸 어떻게 알아요? 지금 이 공간은 마력 때문에 다 뒤틀려: What? How do you know, Letty? Magic has twisted this whole space...
strings.제가 전에 홀라당 속았다고 했잖아여. 마법청사 안에 들어온 적 있어서 기: I told you I got completely fooled before. I've been inside the Bureau. I remember.
strings.대충 로비와 복도에 뭐가 있는지 알고 있어여. 엉망으로 묶여있는 줄을 푸: I know roughly what's in the lobby and corridors. I think of it like untangling a knotted string, and there it is!
strings.넹, 그래여. 그런데 저희 어디까지 가나여?: Yep. But how far are we going?
We need to find out what object Raven needs.
If I knew what it was, I might be able to get it...
strings.정확히 뭔지는 알 수 없어요. 그래서 일단 여길 다 찾아봐야 해요. 어?: We don't know exactly. We'll have to search the place. Huh?
strings.(뒤틀린 마법청사 안이 흔들리면서 어디선가 인공적으로 만들어진 것 같은: (The distorted Bureau shakes, and a strange, seemingly artificial sound echoes from somewhere.)
%s, I found where the sound is coming from.
strings.(그 순간, 어둠 속에서 일행을 노리던 뭔가가 튀어나온다. 그러나 미리: (Something lying in wait lunges from the darkness. But %s saw it coming and strikes it down.)
Are you all right, Letty? But this is...
strings.(레티시아가 쓰러진 존재를 보더니 말을 잇지 못한다.): (Leticia looks at the fallen creature and falls silent.)
strings.이 사람은 연구를 도와달라던 마법사였어여. 왜 괴물처럼 변해서 공격해 온: That's the mage who asked me to help with the research. Why did he become a monster and attack us... ?
strings.레티, 이러고 있을 시간이 없어요. 저기, 우리가 가려고 했던 방향을 봐: There's no time, Letty. Look where we were heading.
strings.(얼마 전까지 사람이었던 존재들이 괴물로 변해 %s 일행을 빤히 바라보고: (Beings that were human until recently stare at %s and Leticia, now monstrous. Leticia falters at the sight of them poised to attack.)
strings.자세히 설명할 수는 없지만, 마법청사 안에 남아있던 마법사들은 다 저렇게: I can't explain everything, but the mages who stayed inside the Bureau may all have become like that.
strings.이 안에 들어온 이상, 우리는 다시 나갈 수 없어요. 이대로 나간다면 글: Now that we're here, we can't simply turn back. Leaving like this could put Glaston in even greater danger.
I understand. I'll pull myself together.
strings.(레티시아가 가볍게 웃으며 모험가와 눈을 맞춘다. 그리고 누가 먼저라고: (Leticia gives the adventurer a small smile. Together, they charge at the creatures rushing toward them.)
strings.(레티시아가 다리에 힘이 풀린 건지 뒤틀린 계단의 손잡이를 붙잡고 일어선: (Her legs apparently weakening, Leticia grips the twisted staircase's railing and pulls herself upright.)
I-I'm fine. I've never fought so many enemies before...
strings.조금 쉴래요?: Would you like a short rest?
strings.(레티가 %s에게서 받아든 포션을 마시고는 가볍게 기지개를 켠다.): (Letty drinks the potion %s hands her, then stretches.)
I think this is it. I can feel something behind there.
(As %s and Leticia move forward, something like a monster's cry reaches them.)
strings.(일행을 기다리고 있던 것처럼 으르렁거리던 울음소리가 미세하게 조금씩 커: (The growling slowly swells, as though awaiting them. Yet there is no trace of a monster in the enclosed space.)
strings.소리만 들리고 왜 아무것도 없지…?: Why can we hear it, but see nothing... ?
strings.(레티시아가 가리킨 곳 뒤에서 알 수 없는 것이 날아오른다.): (Something unrecognizable rises into the air behind the spot Leticia points to.)
strings.(둥둥 떠다니는 마법서 뒤로 이상한 소리를 내는 커다란 유령 같은 존재가: (An enormous, ghostlike being appears behind the floating spellbook, making a strange noise.)
strings.(정령인지 악마인지 알 수 없는 기묘한 형태의 존재가 두 사람을 응시한다: (The oddly shaped creature stares at them. It is impossible to tell whether it is a spirit or a demon.)
I'm not sure, but I think that monster is what did this to the Magic Bureau.
strings.(두 사람이 경계를 하면서 괴물을 상대할 틈을 노리고 있을 때쯤, 멀리서: (As they watch for an opening to attack the monster, Raven appears in the distance.)
strings.여러 금서 중 봉인이 풀린 건 노토리아 뿐이군. 나머진 내가 직접 푸는: So Notoria is the only forbidden tome whose seal has broken. I'll have to unseal the rest myself.
strings.(노토리아라는 이름으로 불린 괴물이 레이븐을 바라보며 소리를 지른다.): (The monster called Notoria turns toward Raven and roars.)
strings.노토리아. 원하는 대로 해줄 테니까 잠깐 기다려,: Notoria. I'll give you what you want. Just wait a moment.
strings.(레이븐의 말대로 노토리아의 움직임이 느려진다. 만족한 듯한 레이븐이 노: (Notoria slows its movements at Raven's words. Looking satisfied, Raven walks past it.)
Where are the other forbidden tomes...? They should be around here...
strings.레이븐, 멈춰. 뭐 하는 거야?: Raven, stop. What are you doing?
strings.나는 필요한 걸 찾으면 바로 나갈 거야. 너희와 상대하고 싶지 않다. 상: I'll leave as soon as I find what I need. I have no desire to deal with you, and no time for it either.
strings.금서를 찾겠다고 마법청사를 이렇게 만든 거야?: You did all this to the Magic Bureau just to find those books?
strings.금서에 대해 알고 있군. 너희들도 금서를 찾고 있는 건가? 왜? 찾는다고: You know about the forbidden tomes. Are you looking for them too? Why? Even if you find them, you couldn't use them.
strings.(레이븐이 %s의 질문을 무시한 채 계속해서 주위를 두리번거린다.): (Raven ignores %s's question and keeps looking around.)
strings.레이븐! 당신이 뭘 하려는지 모르겠지만 멈춰. 마법청사를 원래대로 돌려놓: Raven! Whatever you're planning, stop. Put the Magic Bureau back the way it was. People have turned into monsters!
strings.마법사님, 뭔 소리예여? 사람이 뭔지 몰라여?: What are you talking about, Mr. Mage? Don't you know what people are?
strings.레이븐. 이대로는 마법청 안에 있는 마법사들은 물론이거니와 글래스턴 주민: Raven. You're endangering everyone in Glaston, as well as the mages in this building. Stop what you're doing.
strings.오랜 시간을 들여서 만들었던 걸 네가 망쳤는데, 내가 왜 멈춰야 하지?: You destroyed something I spent so long creating. Why should I stop?
strings.제레니스가 멈추라고 했을 때도 난 멈추지 않았어…! 내겐 사명이 있으니까: I didn't stop when Jerenis told me to...! I have a calling.
For this world, a world without a god... For all the lives within it...
strings.연구에 연구를 거듭했는데, 네가 망쳤지. 그래도 괜찮아. 내겐 다시 할: I researched and researched, and you ruined it. But that's all right. I still have the power to try again. I can start over.
Find a place to nourish it, create a vessel...
strings.이러니 마법사들이 사회성 없다는 소리를 듣져. 어두운 곳에 틀어박혀 이상: This is why everyone says mages have no social skills. You shut yourselves away in the dark, reading weird books and saying weird things.
Letty... That mage has committed terrible crimes. Argent is hunting him down.
Really? So he's a bad guy. We'd better catch him and teach him a lesson.
(Raven stops searching for the forbidden tomes and frowns at them.)
strings.금서에서 깨어난 원초적인 힘이여. 많은 천사와 악마를 죽이고 얻은 피와: Primordial power awakened from a forbidden tome. Blood and tears taken from countless slaughtered angels and demons. Soon I shall forge the key to set you free.
strings.게티아, 테우르기아, 폴리나, 알마델, 노바를 찾을 동안 저 앞에 있는: Kill those two while I find Goetia, Theurgia, Paulina, Almadel, and Nova!
strings.(레이븐의 말과 함께 잠시 멈춰있던 노토리아가 그 자리에서 떠오른다.): (At Raven's command, the motionless Notoria rises into the air.)
strings.(그러더니 이 세상에 없을 것 같은 소름 끼치는 소리를 내며 두 사람에게: (It lunges at them with a chilling cry that seems to belong to no creature of this world.)
strings.(레이븐이 %s의 일격에 연기처럼 흩어지는 에고 노토리아의 모습을 보고: (Raven watches in disbelief as %s's strike disperses Ego Notoria like smoke. He is so shocked that he drops the book he is holding.)
N-Notoria, gone just like that...? I... I don't believe it...
strings.세계의 진리 일부를 형상화한 사념체가 일개 모험가의 손에 소멸한다는 건: A thoughtform embodying part of the world's truth, destroyed by a mere adventurer? That's impossible...
strings.…네가 신의 가호를 받아서? 아니야. 그렇다고 해도 내가 어떻게 봉인을: ...Because you have a god's blessing? No. Even so, after all I went through to break the seal... How could you...
strings.이게 다시 책으로 돌아와야 완벽해진단 말이다!!: It had to return to the book to become complete!
strings.(에고 노토리아가 사라지면서 함께 했던 금서 또한 그림자로 얼룩지더니 이: (As Ego Notoria vanishes, shadows stain the forbidden tome that accompanied it. The book crumbles into ash.)
It's over, Raven. Admit what you've done and answer for your crimes.
strings.%s 님, 멋져여. 악당을 쓰러뜨린 히어로 같아여!: That was amazing, %s! You're like a hero defeating the villain!
strings.(레이븐이 아무렇지도 않은 듯 떨어뜨린 책을 다시 주워 든다.): (Raven calmly picks up the book he dropped.)
strings.잘못? 죄? 내가 뭘 잘못했지?: Crimes? What exactly have I done wrong?
strings.초월적 힘을 가진 자들처럼 했을 뿐이다. 어리석은 자들을 위해 올바른 길: I merely did what those with transcendent power do. I showed the ignorant the right path...
That's absurd. What gives you the right to treat other human beings like...
I have no particular desire to make you understand.
strings.몇백 년을 기다렸던 내가 겨우 이 순간… 노토리아 하나 없어졌다고 계획을: I've waited centuries for this moment... I won't abandon my plans just because I've lost Notoria...
strings.(레이븐이 들고 있던 책 하나를 펼쳐 그 위에 손을 올려놓는다.): (Raven opens one of the books he is carrying and places a hand upon it.)
strings.허튼짓하면 혼나여!!: Try anything funny and you'll be sorry!
strings.(레티시아가 빠른 속도로 레이븐을 향해 발차기하려는 순간, 마법청사가 엄: (Leticia darts forward to kick Raven, but the Magic Bureau begins to shake violently.)
(Leaving the fallen Leticia behind, the adventurer charges at Raven. But his spell stretches the warped space between them, carrying him farther away.)
Paulina, who binds all things within eternal time... All that lies within this space...
strings.(레이븐이 주문을 다 외우기 전에 그의 품에 있던 책이 떠오른다.): (Before Raven can finish his incantation, the book rises out of his grasp.)
strings.(모험가가 높이 뛰어올라 다가오는 책을 붙잡는다. 그러자 흔들리고 있던: (The adventurer leaps up and catches the approaching book. The Magic Bureau stops shaking.)
strings.(금서의 힘에 지배당했던 마법청사가 비록 일부지만, 조금씩 원래의 모습으: (Little by little, parts of the Magic Bureau begin to recover their original form, freed from the forbidden tome's power.)
strings.(그리고 멀어졌던 레이븐과의 거리도 다시 좁혀진다.): (The space separating them from Raven shrinks again.)
strings.젠장, 젠장!! 왜 여기서…. 나, 남아있는 책이라도 지켜야 해…. 보,: Damn it! Damn it! Why now...? I... I have to protect the remaining books... Break their seals...
strings.(레티시아가 대답과 함께 더는 도망갈 곳이 없어 보이는 레이븐의 다리를: (Leticia tackles Raven's legs before he can escape, then uses a chain she has ready to bind his wrists.)
strings.레이븐, 이 책의 어떤 내용이 널 이렇게 만든 거지?: Raven, what did you read in this book that made you do all this?
strings.(레이븐이 눈을 감은 채 입을 굳게 다문다. 붙잡혀 있는 상태지만 여전히: (Raven closes his eyes and clamps his mouth shut. Even bound, he refuses to let go of the three books.)
I don't think we're getting an answer out of him, %s.
...We'll hand him over to the knights.
Shall we head outside? Don't worry about our prisoner. I've tied him up nice and tight.
I've done my duty as a knight. Now I can finally take a break. Hehe.
strings.(레이븐은 이 책에서 뭘 보고 그런 짓을 한 거지….): (What did Raven see in this book that drove him to do those things...?)
strings.(모험가가 그렇게 생각하고 책을 바라본 순간, 눈앞에 보이는 모든 것이: (The moment the adventurer looks at the book, everything before them freezes.)
strings.(어디선가 흘러온 어둠이 모든 걸 가득 메운 순간, 한 번도 들어본 적: (Darkness seeps in from nowhere and fills the world. A voice %s has never heard before whispers in their ear.)
strings.「그렇다면 아르스 폴리나의 일부를 열람할 수 있도록 하겠다. 그대에게 도: 『Then I shall allow you to read a portion of Ars Paulina. These records of time may be of use to you.』
strings.「다만, 이 시간은 원래 그대의 것이 아니기에 짧을 것이다.」: 『But this time is not yours to keep. You will have only a moment.』
(The adventurer tries to cry out upon regaining their senses, but no sound emerges.)
strings.(에트와르의 시간이 모두 사라진 것 같은 공간. 여러 장의 종이가 빛을: (It is as though all of Etoile's time has vanished from this space. Glowing pages drift around the adventurer as if stirred by a breeze.)
strings.(종이를 향해 손을 뻗는 것 외에는 아무것도 할 수 있는 게 없다.): (There is nothing they can do except reach toward the pages.)
strings.(…이 공간을 만든 존재가 다른 행동을 하지 말라고 막아놓은 것 같은데…: (...Whoever made this place seems to be preventing me from doing anything else. What should I do?)
strings.(모험가가 고민하고 있을 동안 빛을 발하고 있던 종이들이 바닥에 떨어진다: (As the adventurer hesitates, glowing pages fall to the floor. Once swallowed by the darkness, they can no longer be seen.)
strings.(…이래서 시간이 없다고 했던 건가. 이제 몇 장 남지 않았네. 서두르자: (...So that's what they meant about having little time. Only a few pages left. I'd better hurry.)
strings.(셋 중 어떤 걸 선택할까?): (Which of the three should I choose?)
strings.(모험가가 파란빛이 맴도는 페이지에 손을 올려놓는다. 그러자 페이지에서: (The adventurer touches the page glowing blue. Its light rises into the air and takes the shape of someone's image.)
You've gathered more mages since my last visit.
strings.머리가 똑똑한 자들의 믿음은 단순하면서도 깊지. 새로운 진리와 지식을 갈: The faith of intelligent people is simple, yet profound. They believe that their hunger for new truths and knowledge can change the world.
strings.나도 그렇고, 이들도 그렇고. 일은 순조롭게 진행 중이야. 당신 덕분도: I believe it. So do they. Our work is proceeding smoothly, in part thanks to you.
strings.아론, 마녀의 힘 말이지. 얼마나 모은 거야?: Aaron. How much of the witches' power have you collected?
strings.처음엔 당신이 나란 인간을 알아보고 제안한 것에 흥미를 느꼈지. 그동안: At first, I was intrigued by your proposal. You seemed to understand the kind of man I am. But even after everything we've done together, you still keep so many secrets.
strings.당신이 나를 알아볼 때, 나도 당신을 알아봤었지. 티에네스 가문을 이끄는: When you recognized me, I recognized you too. I found it fascinating that no one realized the head of House Tienes was always the same being...
strings.덕분에 방해자 제레니스도 죽일 수 있었고, 마신을 만들 수인들도 잔뜩 모: Thanks to you, I killed Jerenis before he could interfere further, and gathered plenty of beastfolk to create a demon god. I am grateful for that.
strings.세계의 진리를 엿본 내가 당신 같은 마족이 하는 걸 모를 거라 생각해?: I've glimpsed the truth of this world. Did you think I wouldn't see what a demon like you was doing? You're waiting for a witch to be born into the imperial family.
It all ends when that day comes, doesn't it? When you can finally achieve whatever it is you want...
strings.토끼 귀 마녀하고는 어떤 거래를 했지? 계속해서 그릇을 만들어 달라고 했: What bargain did you strike with the rabbit-eared witch? You asked her to keep making vessels for you.
strings.그 여자의 아이가 죽지 않는 것이다. 그것만 이뤄진다면 나와의 거래는 영: Her child must not die. As long as that condition is fulfilled, her bargain with me will never end.
Then that rabbit witch must be holding the power of all the witches you've killed.
strings.(어둠 속에서 흐릿하게 보였던 잔상이 점점 사라져 더는 보이지 않는다.): (The faint images in the darkness gradually fade from sight.)
strings.(모험가가 노란 빛이 맴도는 페이지에 손을 올려놓는다. 그러자 페이지에서: (The adventurer touches the page glowing yellow. Its light rises into the air and takes the shape of someone's image.)
The experiments using fear are progressing smoothly, but I don't know when they'll be complete...
They will be needed when the time comes. Until then, I can wait.
When that happens, I'd appreciate being left out of the Demon Realm's plans...
strings.생각해 보겠다, 크롤리. 그런데…, 저 아이가 이번에 만들어진 그릇인가?: I'll consider it, Crowley. Now... is that child your latest vessel?
strings.이번에 만들어진 그릇은 꽤 괜찮아. 오랫동안 많은 영혼을 섞고, 라슈에트: This vessel is quite promising. I spent a long time blending many souls together, then left it to dream in LaChouette's waterways.
strings.깨어나선 잠들어 있던 고대 마도골렘을 깨우더군. 꽤 괜찮은 그릇이야. 좀: When it awoke, it roused an ancient magic golem from its slumber. A very promising vessel. The only drawback is that its emotions haven't stabilized yet.
So I made use of a certain nobleman. You've heard the rumors about the Gentleman, haven't you...?
strings.그가 수로에 죽은 자들을 던져 넣었을 때 문제가 좀 생겼어. 그때 그릇이: There was a problem when he dumped the dead into the waterways. The vessel escaped and hid in a storeroom at the Magic Bureau.
strings.겨우 붙잡긴 했지만, 그새 자신을 구해주려던 사람 하나를 죽였더군. 오랜: I barely managed to recapture it. In the meantime, it had killed someone who tried to save it. The mages had tormented it for so long, it assumed he would do the same.
strings.네모 같은 마법사가 죽은 건 아깝지만, 노네임에게는 새로운 경험이 됐을: It's a shame to lose a mage like Nemo, but it must have been a new experience for No Name. And this vessel is better than Atalante, who is slated for disposal.
strings.그건 그렇고 럭스. 황제를 죽인 것도 계획에 있는 거야? 바르바토스라는: By the way, Lux. Was killing the emperor part of your plan too? And what about that demon, Barbatos?
strings.시이나 황녀가 제국의 초대 황제인 그 여자의 환생이란 건 나도 알고 있어: I know Princess Shiina is the reincarnation of that woman, the empire's first sovereign. But apart from her exceptional magical power...
You're a curious human. Very well, I'll answer.
I don't know which of the three sisters is destined to become a witch, but...
strings.(모험가가 붉은빛이 맴도는 페이지에 손을 올려놓는다. 그러자 페이지에서: (The adventurer touches the page glowing red. Its light rises into the air and takes the shape of someone's image.)
Master, no matter what you say, I will pursue my ambition.
strings.「인간은 인간인 상태에서 할 수 있는 일만 해야 한다. 지금 네가 하려는: 『Humans must stay within the bounds of their humanity. What you propose would deny humanity itself!』
strings.선생님께선 마법은 인간을 위해 존재하는 것이다, 라고 항상 말씀하셨습니다: You always said that magic exists to serve humanity, Master. That was why you used it to help the people.
I followed your teachings, but I felt that wasn't enough.
strings.선생님께서 대마법사라 불리는 것은 일반 사람들이 사용할 수 없는 마법을: People call you an archmage because you can wield magic that ordinary people cannot. It is a blessing.
strings.소수만이 누릴 수 있는 축복을 마법을 쓰지 못하는 자들을 위해 쓰는 것이: In this world, those few who possess that blessing are expected to use it for those who cannot wield magic.
And that is why I intend to go further for their sake.
For Freios, abandoned by the gods, I will uncover the ancient truths that others have barely touched...
strings.「금기로 정하고, 금서로 봉인한 건 다 이유가 있다!!」: 『Those things were forbidden and sealed away in those books for a reason!』
Even so, a taboo can simply be broken. A forbidden book can simply be read.
strings.당신의 마법은 너무 구태의연해서 못 봐주겠습니다. 이제 제가 당신의 의지: Your magic is so antiquated that I can hardly bear to watch. I will carry on your will from here...
Jerenis, the narrow-minded, foolish mage I once respected as my teacher...
(The glowing pages fall to the floor and disappear into the darkness.)
strings.(눈을 찌르는 엄청난 빛에 모험가가 놀라 주위를 두리번거린다. 그러자 걱: (Startled by a blinding light, the adventurer looks around and meets Leticia's worried gaze.)
Are you all right, %s? Cough, cough...
strings.(레티시아가 입술에 묻은 피를 닦으며 미안한 표정을 짓는다.): (Leticia wipes blood from her lips, looking apologetic.)
strings.나는 괜찮은데, 레티는 왜 그래요?: I'm fine, but what happened to you, Letty?
I should've held on to that mage more tightly...
strings.기억 안 나세여? 레이븐을 붙잡고 밖으로 나오려는데, %s 님이 크롤리라: Don't you remember? We were taking Raven outside when you muttered 'Crowley,' %s!
Raven suddenly looked startled, and then the spellbook exploded.
strings.그래서 우리 밖으로 날아갔잖아여! 기억 안 나세여?: It sent us flying out of the building! Don't you remember?
strings.정말 기억 안 나시는군여. 어쨌든 레이븐이 그 틈을 타서 도망가서 정령왕: You really don't remember, huh? Anyway, Raven escaped in the confusion, and the Spirit King went after him!
strings.정령왕님이 신비한 버섯을 주셨는데, 그거 먹었더니 괜찮아졌어여. %s 님: The Spirit King gave me a mysterious mushroom. I felt better after eating it. Would you like one too, %s?
(Just then, Peekaboo spots something from the sky and hoots at them.)
strings.피카부가 저쪽에서 뭔가 본 것 같아여. 피카부, 저기 저쪽에 정령왕님 있: I think Peekaboo saw something over there. Peekaboo, is the Spirit King that way?
strings.%s 님, 피카부 말대로 저쪽으로 가봐여. 정말 괜찮은 거 맞져?: Let's follow Peekaboo's directions, %s. You're sure you're okay?
I'm fine, Letty. Nothing hurts. Oh, I can see something over there...
You know, one of those gates powered by magic. There are some at the Nereis Gateway too.
strings.마법청 마법사들이 언젠가 세워뒀다고 하는데, 지금은 안 써서 방치해두고: The Magic Bureau's mages put it up ages ago, but nobody uses it now. It's just been left there.
Running that way won't do him any good...
strings.알았어염, 그러면 몬스터 피해서 친구들하고 광장 쪽으로 가여, 알았져?: Okay, then. Stay away from the monsters and take your friends to the square, all right?
strings.(레티시아를 따라 행정 지구 안쪽으로 뛰어가자 조금 전 들었던 설명대로: (Following Leticia deeper into the administrative district, the adventurer finds the huge, disused gate she described.)
strings.(실피드가 게이트 위에 앉아 하늘을 멍하니 바라본다.): (Sylphid sits atop the gate, gazing blankly at the sky.)
strings.찌르르. 이거 어떻게 한다?: Chirrr. What am I supposed to do about this?
strings.찌르. 두 사람, 괜찮냐?: Chirp. Are you two all right?
strings.일단은 괜찮은 것 같아요. 실피드님, 드릴 말씀이 있는데….혹시 이거 아: We seem to be. Sylphid, there's something I need to tell you... Do you know anything about this?
strings.(실피드에게 아르스 폴리나와 관련된 이야기를 한다.): (The adventurer tells Sylphid about Ars Paulina.)
strings.찌르르. 너 말이야…. 찌르. 정령왕인 나도 모르는 그런 영역에 다녀온: Chirrr. You... Chirp. It sounds like you've visited a realm even I know nothing about, and I'm a Spirit King. How should I put it...
Chirrr. First, about Raven. Or rather, Crowley.
strings.찌르. 금서에 있는 내용, 세계의 진리라고 했던 원초적인 힘. 그걸 사용: Chirp. The contents of those forbidden tomes, that primordial power he called the truth of the world... To use it, you must stake everything you are.
strings.찌르르. 그렇지 않으면 인간이든 뭐든 힘을 내주지 않아. 원래 힘이 있어: Chirrr. Otherwise, it won't lend its power to anyone, human or otherwise. You need power of your own to begin with, too... Anyway, it seems Crowley wagered himself to tamper with those tomes and break their seals.
strings.찌르. 그중 하나가 실체화됐고, 네 손에 쓰러졌어. 게다가 다른 힘이 널: Chirp. One of those powers took physical form, and you defeated it. And if another power recognized you and showed you Crowley's past...
Chirp. Crowley won't be able to use what he read in the forbidden tomes anymore. However...
strings.그 사회성 없는 아저씨가 그 힘을 사용할 수 있는 공간에 갔다고 말씀하시: You're saying that antisocial old guy went somewhere he could still use that power, right?
Chirrr. Exactly. You're quick on the uptake, kid.
strings.이 게이트가 그 역할을 하고, 크롤리가 갈 수 있는 곳이라면…, 혹시 마: If this gate leads somewhere Crowley can do that... Could it be the Demon Realm...
strings.찌르. 네 말이 맞다. 이 게이트 너머는 마계야. 희미하게 느껴지는 걸: Chirp. You're right. Beyond this gate lies the Demon Realm. I can only sense it faintly, so it must be very far away, but they're definitely connected.
Chirrr. I did hear that the journey to the Demon Realm is longer than you might think...
If he uses the forbidden tomes' power in the Demon Realm, things could get even worse. We have to open this gate...
Chirrr. Only demons can open a gate to the Demon Realm.
Chirrr. The Demon Realm is another world beyond the Great Wall, one that exists in defiance of everything here. To reach it from our world requires the power of a god.
strings.찌르. 맞아. 위대한 벽을 구축하고 계신 이리스 님께서 손을 써주셔야 하: Chirp. Yes. We would need the help of Lady Iris, who maintains the Great Wall.
strings.정령왕님, 그분 지금 어디 계세여? 어디 계시는지만 알려주시면 제가 빨리: Where is she, Spirit King? Just tell me where to go, and I'll hurry over there.
It's all right, Letty. I can talk to her.
strings.(%s의 말과 함께 어디선가 빛의 구가 일행의 앞에 나타나 반짝거린다.): (At %s's words, a glowing orb appears before the group.)
Hello, Sylphid. And hello to you too, Leticia.
strings.어, 어디서 들려오는 목소리져? 반짝거리는 이거 맞져?: Wh-where's that voice coming from? This shiny thing, right?
Chirp. Calm down, kid. It's the goddess.
strings.우와, 말로만 듣던 여신님이시라구여?: Wow, the goddess I've heard so much about?!
Iris, I need your help... if we're going to pursue Crowley.
strings.괜찮아요. 크롤리를 쫓는 게 먼저잖아요. 이 구역의 일부분을 잠시 재구성: It's all right. Catching Crowley comes first. I'll briefly reconstruct part of this area. That should make it possible, if only for a moment.
We don't have much time. Everyone, stand back.
All right, Iris. Letty, get behind me.
(The orb moves before the empty gate and grows larger. A figure emerges from within it, seemingly clothed in all the world's purest, most beautiful light.)
strings.(전에는 볼 수 없었던 새로운 모습의 이리스가 한 손에 커다란 활을 든: (Iris stands before the gate in a form the adventurer has never seen before, a great bow in her hand.)
My name is Iris, descendant of the Derr whom Lady Seres left behind.
strings.나의 세계여. 눈을 뜨고 감은 모든 생명의 이름을 거룩히 기억하는 우리의: O world of mine. Our world, which holds sacred the names of all who have opened their eyes to life and closed them in death.
strings.(이리스의 말이 끝나자 하늘에서 빛줄기가 날아와 세레스티아를 맴돈다. 맴: (Shafts of light descend from the sky and circle Celestia. They flow to Iris's fingertips and become a beautiful arrow of light.)
strings.부정한 어둠을 뚫을 것이니 나와 데르의 활, 세레스티아 끝에서 빛이 되어: I shall pierce this unholy darkness. Become the light at the tip of Celestia, the bow of the Derr that I now wield.
strings.(점점 날카로워진 빛의 화살이 세레스티아에서 벗어나 그대로 앞으로 향한다: (The arrow grows sharper and sharper, then flies forth from Celestia.)
(With a piercing whistle, the arrow strikes the empty center of the gate.)
strings.(이어 보이지 않던 벽이 갈라지고, 일부는 파편처럼 바닥에 떨어져 먼지처: (An invisible wall splits apart. Fragments fall to the ground and dissolve into dust.)
strings.(닫혀있던 게이트 너머로 보기만 해도 불길함이 잔뜩 느껴지는 길이 보인다: (Beyond the formerly sealed gate stretches a road steeped in menace. At its end, a castle gleams beneath a violet moon.)
The Demon Realm begins at the castle at the end of that road. I'm sorry, %s.
I wish I could pursue Raven with you, but if I set even one foot in the Demon Realm... beings from other worlds will come for this one.
They will say that even one of its last remaining gods has abandoned Etoile... Go. Hurry.
Chirp. Lady Iris is right, %s. Leave things here to me.
strings.나쁜 놈 잡으러 저도 갈 거예여!: I'm going too! We've got a bad guy to catch!
strings.찌르르. 꼬맹아. 정령인 나도 가기에 위험한 곳인데, 일반 인간이 가는: Chirrr. Kid, that place would be dangerous even for a spirit like me. It's much worse for an ordinary human.
Chirp. Stay here and help me keep other monsters from coming through.
I guess there's no helping it. Okay.
(Leticia points into the gate, having spotted Raven on the other side.)
strings.(조금 전까지도 보이지 않았던 레이븐이 마법서를 끌어 안은채 불안한 듯: (Raven, nowhere to be seen a moment ago, clutches the spellbooks and looks around anxiously.)
I'll catch Raven—Crowley—and make him answer for what he's done.
strings.(모험가는 자신을 배웅하는 모두를 뒤로한 채 게이트 안 - 마계의 경계선: (Leaving the others behind, the adventurer runs through the gate and into the passage bordering the Demon Realm.)
strings.(파란 구름 위로 세워진 커다란 길이 보랏빛을 맞으며 끝없이 펼쳐져 있다: (A vast road stretches endlessly over blue clouds, bathed in violet light. Ominous red liquid stains its surface.)
It looks like blood... but not quite. Huh? What's that...?
strings.(사람이 수십, 수백 명을 채울 수 있을 정도의 커다란 원 형태의 구간: (A magic circle covers a round stretch of road large enough to hold dozens, perhaps hundreds of people. Blue flames surround it.)
strings.(주위를 살펴보고 있던 %s의 눈에 다시 길을 헤매고 있는 레이븐의 모습: (As %s looks around, Raven comes into view again, seemingly lost.)
I can catch up to him from here.
strings.(조금 전까지 불안해 보였던 것과는 달리 레이븐이 %s에게 깊은 조소를: (His earlier anxiety gone, Raven gives %s a sneering smile, then races toward the castle.)
strings.저 끝에서 뭘 꾸미고 있는지는 모르겠지만…, 당신 뜻대로는 안 될 거야…: Whatever you're planning at the end of this road... I won't let you have your way, Crowley.
strings.(얼마나 달려갔는지, 얼마나 깊게 들어갔는지 모를 정도의 커다란 공간 속: (In a space so vast that %s can no longer tell how far or how deep they have run, they finally stop.)
strings.(더는 나아갈 수 없는 막다른 길 앞에 레이븐이 멈춰서서 모험가를 바라보: (Raven stands at a dead end, facing the adventurer.)
You've stopped running. There's nowhere left to go, Raven.
strings.(크롤리라는 이름이 %s의 입에서 흘러나오자 레이븐이 씨익 웃는다.): (Raven grins as the name Crowley leaves %s's lips.)
strings.다른 사람의 입에서 그 이름을 들어본 게 언제였더라. 내가 레이븐이라는: When did I last hear someone else call me that? I have lived as Raven for a very long time.
strings.무슨 말이 하고 싶은 거야?: What are you trying to say?
strings.아르스 폴리나에서 내 과거를 봤다면 내가 어떤 사람인지 알고 있겠지?: If you saw my past in Ars Paulina, you must know what kind of man I am.
But if you insist on hearing it...
You murdered the mage Jerenis and tried to use the forbidden tomes to create a demon god...
You incited the mages and used the people of Creed as materials for that god...
strings.…많은 사람들이 죽었어. 그게 뭐라고, 당신이 뭐라고. 왜 그런 짓을 한: ...So many people died. For what? Who gave you the right? Why did you do it?
strings.(침묵을 지킨 채 모험가를 바라보던 레이븐의 얼굴에 미소가 피어오른다.): (Raven listens in silence, then a smile spreads across his face.)
strings.신의 가호를 받는 특별한 인간이 아무것도 모르는구나. 힘이 있어도 쓰지: A special human blessed by a god, and you understand nothing. Just like that fool Jerenis, who had power and refused to use it.
strings.서로 싸우던 신들이 비스트에게 잡아먹혔거나 도망갔어. 신들의 빈자리를 마: The gods fought amongst themselves until Beast devoured them or drove them away. The Demon King took their place. And what have the gods done all this time?
strings.나는 이 세계가 너무 불쌍했어. 그래서 새로운 세상을 만들고 싶어서 노력: I pitied this world. I worked to create a new one.
strings.그런데 제레니스가 세계의 진리를 보고 왔네? 그 속에 힘이 있어서 그걸: Then Jerenis returned after witnessing the truth of the world. There was power there. He could have brought it back...
strings.봉인하고 아무것도 하지 않았지. 어리석은 인간. 내가 그렇게 쓰자고 부탁: But he sealed it away and did nothing. Foolish man. I begged him to use it, but he kept ignoring me...
strings.그래서 난 그를 죽이고, 그의 힘으로 봉인을 풀었고, 진리를 엿보고 왔다: So I killed him, used his power to break the seal, and glimpsed the truth myself. His death wasn't my fault. He brought it upon himself.
strings.그걸 말이라고 하는 거야?: How can you even say that?
strings.새로운 세계의 주인이 될 신을 만들라는 메시지를 듣고, 나는 그걸 내 사: I heard a message telling me to create a god to rule a new world. I made that my calling.
I founded research institutes connected to the Magic Bureau and worked tirelessly for years.
For this pitiful world whose gods have vanished...
For the lives in this pitiful world...
I undertook this work and its sacrifices on everyone's behalf.
And the only one who understood me was a demon. Heh.
Call me insane if you wish. This is my calling, and I merely follow it.
I shall continue my work here, %s.
strings.생각해 보니 그릇을 새로 오랜 시간 다시 만들 필요가 없을 것 같아서 말: It occurred to me that I needn't spend all those years creating another vessel. There's excellent material right here.
strings.너 스스로 재료가 되진 않겠지. 그래서 진리의 힘을 보여주겠다. 완벽하지: You won't offer yourself willingly, of course. So I will show you the power of truth. Even incomplete, it will be enough to turn you into my material.
Though I don't much care for doing this in a place Lux provided...
strings.(레이븐이 안경을 바닥에 집어 던지곤 들고 있던 금서를 모두 펼친다. 그: (Raven flings his glasses to the ground and opens all the forbidden tomes in his arms. He begins muttering feverishly.)
Goetia, essence of evil buried by the ancient god in the darkness of the beginning.
Theurgia, primal force of life with which the ancient god created the spirits.
Almadel, power of obedience through which the ancient god commands the angels.
Nova, star of the abyss that pours forth every wound and tear.
strings.…이 불쌍한 세계를 위해 내가 다시 신을 만들 테니 힘을 다오!!: ...Lend me your power, that I may once again create a god for this pitiful world!
(Shadows pour from the open tomes amid grotesque sounds. They swell around Raven and the books, blocking the adventurer's approach.)
Ugh... I... I can't get close...
strings.(검은 그림자와 함께 발생한 소용돌이 때문에 모험가가 계속해서 뒤로 밀려: (A vortex forms amid the black shadows, driving the adventurer backward.)
Hahahahaha! Yes, this is it! This is true power! Hahahahaha!
strings.(레이븐이 힘겹게 자신에게 덤벼드는 뭔가를 상대하고 있지만, 잘 보이지: (Raven struggles against something attacking him, but it is difficult to see.)
strings.(잠시 후, 소용돌이가 옅어지면서 살짝 보인 것은 마수처럼 송곳니를 드러: (As the vortex thins, the adventurer glimpses a forbidden tome baring its fangs like a monstrous beast.)
strings.크, 크아아악!! 그, 그만해!! 왜, 왜 나를…. 아아악!!: G-GAAAAH! S-stop! Why... Why me...? Aaaagh!
(The four tomes bite down on Raven's hands and feet, one after another, swallowing them. Shadows gather from the books and gradually form another tome.)
strings.내게 힘만 주면 되는데 왜 이래!! 크아아아악!!: All you had to do was give me power! Why are you doing this?! AAAAAARGH!
strings.(레이븐의 그 말과 함께 레이븐을 빤히 바라보고 있던 새로운 책은 입을: (The new book stares at Raven, then opens its mouth wide and bites down, engulfing his head.)
strings.(잠시 후, 그림자 사이에서 선혈이 솟아오른다.): (A moment later, fresh blood sprays from the shadows.)
strings.(힘겹게 버티던 레이븐의 목소리가 점점 작아진다. 이어 레이븐의 팔과 다: (Raven's desperate cries grow fainter. His arms and legs fall limp, then drop to the ground.)
strings.(잠시 후, 레이븐의 앞에서 일어났던 그림자와 소용돌이가 사라지고 참혹한: (The shadows and vortex fade, leaving only a horrific sight behind.)
strings.(크롤리의 머리를 삼킨 책 위로 악마의 뿔 같은 것이 돋아난다. 이어 바: (Demonlike horns sprout from the book that swallowed Crowley's head. The red liquid staining the ground rises and rushes toward him.)
strings.(피와 어둠에 삼켜진 인간은 어느새 사람에게서 멀어진 기괴한 괴물의 형태: (Consumed by blood and darkness, the human becomes a grotesque monster, barely resembling what he once was.)
strings.(레이븐이면서 크롤리였던 괴물이 정신을 차리고 주위를 바라본다. 그러자: (The monster who was both Raven and Crowley regains its senses and looks around. The ground beneath the adventurer begins to shake violently.)
strings.마법만 사용하던 그때보다 힘이 느껴지는군. 이게 바로 금서의 힘인가?: I feel more powerful than I ever did wielding mere magic. So this is the power of the forbidden tomes?
This is power that can change the world...
strings.나는 이제 레이븐도, 크롤리도 아니다!! 너를 죽이고, 신을 세울 대행자: I am no longer Raven or Crowley! I am the one who will kill you and raise a god in my stead...
strings.(머리를 금서에게 내준 괴물이 모험가를 응시한다.): (The monster, its head engulfed by a forbidden tome, stares at the adventurer.)
And this is the perfect place to spread the truth of the world. Pseudaria...
strings.(자신을 라우드스키나라고 밝힌 괴물을 감싸듯 커다란 마력이 담긴 링이 만: (A vast ring brimming with magic forms around the monster that calls itself Laudskina.)
As long as I possess this power, you will never return home.
All that boasting over power that isn't even yours...
strings.그 말조차 더는 하지 못하게 해주지. 죽어라, 신의 모험가여!!: I shall silence that mouth forever. Die, adventurer of the goddess!
strings.(크롤리의 머리를 삼킨 책이 쿨럭거리며 붉은색 액체를 토해낸다.): (The book that swallowed Crowley's head coughs up red liquid.)
strings.(힘겹게 버티던 라우드스키나가 다시 %s에게 공격을 퍼붓지만, 강력한 반: (Barely holding on, Laudskina unleashes another barrage at %s, but a powerful counterattack renders it useless.)
This can't be happening. I won't be able to resume my research. I have to...
strings.(라우드스키나가 다시 공격하려고 하지만, 심지어 이번엔 %s에게 닿지도: (Laudskina attacks again, but this time its attack fails to reach %s at all.)
strings.나, 나, 나는 크롤리라고. 강력한 마법 실력으로 마법청장까지 됐고, 오: I... I am Crowley! My mastery of magic made me director of the Magic Bureau. Years of research allowed me to create a demon god. I am a great man!
strings.그런 내가 너 따위 인간을 쓰러뜨리지 못한다니 그, 그건 말이 아, 안: For someone like me to fail to defeat a mere human like you... Th-that's impossible...
I must fulfill my calling. Only then...
strings.네가 사명을 이루면 그 다음엔 뭐가 되는 거지?: And what happens after you fulfill it?
strings.네 손에 만들어진 마신이 널 어떻게 할 거 같아? 가짜가 주인인 세계의: What do you think a demon god you created would do to you? Would the people of a world ruled by a false god be happy? There would be no place in that world for the lives that exist now.
strings.진리를 엿본 내가, 내가 있을 자리는 어디든지 있을 것이다!! 그러니까: I have glimpsed the truth! There will always be a place for me! Now submit and become the material for my vessel...
Even now, you still don't understand.
strings.(라우드스키나를 감싸고 있던 고리가 부서지고, 크롤리였던 자의 몸이 액체: (The ring surrounding Laudskina shatters. The body of the man who was Crowley starts to liquefy and drip away.)
strings.네가 만만하게 봤던 세계는 절대 불쌍하지 않아. 무너져도 일어서고, 계속: The world you thought so little of deserves no pity. It fell and got back up. It kept enduring.
The world isn't the pitiful one...
strings.(%s의 공격이 다시 라우드스키나에게 향하는 순간, 커다란 게 땅에 떨어: (As %s attacks Laudskina again, something large drops to the ground.)
strings.(책이 입을 벌려 크롤리의 머리를 놓아버린 것이었다. 조금 전까지 붙잡혀: (The book has opened its mouth and released Crowley's head. Crowley falls free and tumbles across the ground.)
strings.(모험가가 기괴한 소리를 찾아 고개를 든 순간, 금서가 날카로운 이빨을: (The adventurer looks up at the grotesque sound. The forbidden tome lunges, baring its sharp teeth.)
strings.(그것도 잠시뿐. 금서는 어떤 것도 삼키지 못한 채 %s의 손에서 갈가리: (It lasts only a moment. Before it can swallow anything, %s tears the tome to pieces. Its remains fall onto Crowley's head.)
strings.「안 돼!! 진리가 거기 있는데, 그걸 이렇게 마, 만들다니…. 주, 죽: 『No! The truth is in there! How could you d-do this...? I... I can't let death come any closer...』
strings.(크롤리가 손을 뻗어 발악하지만, 아무것도 하지 못한다. 그저 모험가의: (Crowley reaches out desperately, but can do nothing. The adventurer looks down at him with contempt.)
strings.「마법을 쓸 수 있는 특별한 존재…. 그래서 이 불쌍한 세계를 위해….」: 『A special being who can wield magic... So, for this pitiful world...』
strings.(크롤리의 말이 끝나기도 전에 무기를 쥔 %s의 손에 힘이 들어간다.): (Before Crowley can finish, %s tightens their grip on their weapon.)
strings.「럭스같은 마족을 믿는 게 아니었는데…. 크헉!!」: 『I should never have trusted a demon like Lux... Gah!』
strings.(죄의식 없이 오랜 시간 착각에 빠졌던 자가 그 자리에서 증발하듯 사라진: (The man who spent so long lost in his delusions, untouched by guilt, vanishes as if evaporating. The strange moonlight at the Demon Realm's border illuminates the spot where he lay.)
strings.(그제야 다른 곳으로 갈 수 있는 길 같은 게 보이지만, 모험가를 허락하: (Only then does a passage leading elsewhere become visible. But an unseen wall blocks the adventurer, as if denying them entry.)
That's not what I came here for. For now, I have to go back...
(The road back remains thick with ominous traces of the Demon Realm.)
strings.(럭스를 처단해야 하는데, 제대로 할 수 있을까? 어느 정도 힘을 가졌는: (I have to stop Lux, but can I really do it? I still don't know how powerful he is...)
I'll stop overthinking it. First, I'll go back and talk to Iris.
strings.(모험가가 발걸음을 돌려 다시 왔던 길을 향해 뛰어간다.): (The adventurer turns and runs back the way they came.)
strings.(모험가의 모습이 더는 달빛에 비치지 않을 정도로 멀리 사라지자, 막혀있: (Once the adventurer has gone far enough that the moonlight no longer catches them, someone slowly emerges from the blocked passage toward the Demon Realm.)
At first, I wasn't even sure you'd survive. Now I find myself cheering you on.
strings.(다프네가 조용히 시선을 아래로 옮긴다. 그리고 찢긴 금서의 흔적을 바라: (Daphne lowers her gaze to the torn remains of the forbidden tomes.)
strings.어리석게도 마족을 굳게 믿었군요. 럭스가 레메게톤의 완성을 보려고 자기: How foolish, to put such faith in a demon. You never realized Lux was using you to see Lemegeton completed...
strings.(다프네가 불길한 하늘의 달을 바라보며 입가에 미소를 띤다.): (Daphne looks up at the moon in the ominous sky and smiles.)
There was a reason the gods buried those things you called the truth.
strings.어디선가 이곳을 지켜보면서 듣고 있을 거라 생각해요. 그렇다면 말씀드리죠: I imagine you're watching and listening from somewhere. In that case, let me tell you this.
strings.당신 계획은 이미 엉망이 됐어요. 많은 이들이 당신의 정체와 목적을 알고: Your plan has already fallen apart. Many people know who you are and what you want.
That is why I believe this is the perfect moment.
The moment to make you pay for testing me.
strings.(모험가가 바깥의 경계라고 생각되는 문을 향해 발을 내디딘 순간, 세상의: (The instant the adventurer steps toward what seems to be the exit, the world rushes at them in a dizzying swirl of colors.)
strings.(뭔가 머리에 앉는 느낌이 들어 고개를 들자 작은 파랑새의 파닥거리는 깃: (Feeling something settle on their head, the adventurer looks up to see a little blue bird fluttering its feathers.)
Chirp. Lady Iris couldn't stay away any longer. She has returned.
strings.%s 님, 괜찮아여? 그 나쁜 놈은 어떻게 하셨어여?: Are you okay, %s? What happened to that bad guy?
strings.찌르. 그래, %s. 그 마법사는 어떻게 됐지?: Chirp. Yes, %s. What became of the mage?
strings.(실피드에게 게이트 안에서 일어났던 일을 설명했다.): (The adventurer explains to Sylphid what happened beyond the gate.)
Wow, what an awful person! Still so shameless, right to the very end...
Chirrr. I know how you must be feeling.
strings.좀 지나면 괜찮을 거예요. 그런데, 이제 몬스터들은 없는 건가요?: I'll be all right after a while. Are all the monsters gone now?
They suddenly disappeared, all at once!
strings.찌르. 독기에 취했던 정령은 원래 있던 곳으로 돌아갔고, 마법청의 부엉이: Chirp. The spirits affected by the miasma returned to where they belonged. The Magic Bureau's owl mages came outside and are busy throwing up.
Chirrr. The demons from the Demon Realm fled in a hurry.
strings.그렇군요. 아, 마법청사에 있다가 괴물로 변했던 마법사들은요?: I see. What about the mages who turned into monsters inside the Magic Bureau?
Chirp. Their hearts stopped the moment the forbidden tomes lost their power.
strings.찌르르. 피카부 말을 들어보니 마법사들이 급하게 연구 관련 자료와 표본을: Chirrr. From what Peekaboo told me, they were trying to retrieve research documents and specimens when it happened.
strings.찌르. 레이븐이 자신을 도운 마법사들의 생명으로 금서를 사용할 때 거래했: Chirp. Raven must have bargained away the lives of the mages who helped him in exchange for the tomes' power.
strings.찌르르. %s. 지금은 움직일 때가 아니다. 눈앞에 모이가 있다고 해서: Chirrr. %s. This is no time to rush into action. Don't dive at the first seed you see. There may be a trap.
strings.찌르르. 여기서 보고 들은 것은 모두 비밀이다. 알았지?: Chirrr. Everything you saw and heard here is a secret. Understand?
strings.찌르. 일반 인간이 새처럼 말하는 정령왕도 보고 여신님도 봤다고 하면 안: Chirp. Who would believe an ordinary human who claimed to have met a chirping Spirit King and a goddess?
Chirrr. Think of it as a secret mission.
Wow, like a hero! Got it.
strings.찌르. 병사들이 달려오고 있군. 무슨 일이지? 몬스터나 마족이 더는 없는: Chirp. Soldiers are coming. What's wrong? There aren't any monsters or demons left...
strings.병사들이라면 의회 쪽 병사들인가? 제가 히어로 같은 기사니까 무슨 일인지: Soldiers? Are they from the council? As a heroic knight, I'll go ask what's going on.
strings.(병사들 분위기가 조금 이상한데…. 예전 그때처럼….): (Something feels wrong about those soldiers... Just like that other time...)
strings.(레티시아가 뭐라고 할 틈도 없이 유격병들이 일행을 둘러싼다. 그리고 유: (Before Leticia can speak, the skirmishers surround the group and raise their rifles.)
...The wrath spilling from the Gate of Doom... shall burn everything...
strings.(유격병이 소총의 방아쇠를 당기려는 순간, 커다란 소용돌이가 일어난다.): (Just as a skirmisher is about to pull the trigger, a great whirlwind rises.)
Chirp. They've been brainwashed by the Demon Realm's influence. Kid, take their weapons, quickly!
(Leticia tries to fling the soldiers' rifles away with telekinesis, but drops them instead. The adventurer takes the opportunity to subdue the startled skirmishers.)
strings.(하지만, 그것도 잠시 뿐. 어딘가에서 세뇌당한 유격병들이 나타나 그들을: (The respite is brief. More brainwashed skirmishers appear and surround them again.)
Huff... Huff... There are too many soldiers... And they're ridiculously strong...
strings.찌르르. 일반 인간들이라 기절시키는 게 전부라 시간이 오래 걸리는군. %: Chirrr. They're ordinary humans, so we can only knock them unconscious. That takes time. %s, the soldiers... Wait.
strings.(일행을 둘러싸고 있던 유격병들의 움직임이 멈춘다. 그리고 바다가 갈라지: (The skirmishers surrounding the group stop moving. Their ranks part like the sea, and two people approach %s and the others.)
Now, tell us exactly what you saw.
strings.제 두 눈으로 똑똑히 봤습니다. 저 사람이 마법청 마법사 레이븐을 저 안: I saw it clearly with my own eyes. That person dragged Raven, a mage of the Magic Bureau, in there.
strings.(마법청 소속 마법사 페타가 지금은 작동하지 않는 게이트를 가리킨다.): (Feta, a mage of the Magic Bureau, points at the now-inactive gate.)
strings.마족과 내통하고 마법청 소속 마법사 레이븐을 납치한 혐의. 이 정도면 되: Colluding with demons and abducting Raven of the Magic Bureau. That should suffice.
strings.(병사들이 아론의 말에 약속한 것처럼 %s에게 다가간다. 그러나 %s의: (As though on cue, the soldiers advance toward %s at Aaron's command. But when they see the card in %s's hand, they recoil in surprise.)
I was carrying out an imperial mission concerning Raven.
strings.실례했습니다. 어, 아론 의장께선 여긴 어쩐 일로…?: Our apologies. Huh? Chairman Aaron, what brings you here...?
strings.우리 조금 전까지 의사당에 있지 않았었나?: Weren't we at the council hall a moment ago?
strings.(아론이 뭔가 알아차린 듯 피식 웃는다. 잠시 후, 어디선가 어둠이 밀려: (Aaron gives a small, knowing smile. Darkness surges in from nowhere and blankets the administrative district.)
(Every living thing touched by the darkness stops moving and collapses. Even Sylphid, watching from a tree, falls to the ground.)
strings.(대체 시공간을 어떻게 제어하고 있는 거야? 자, 잠깐?): (How is he controlling space and time like this? W-wait...)
strings.(상황을 파악하기도 전에 허공을 덮었던 어둠이 아론을 향해 날아온다.): (Before the adventurer can understand what is happening, the darkness filling the air rushes toward Aaron.)
Very well. I shall entertain the will of a being rejected by the world. Daphne.
I'll postpone dealing with you. You had better stay alive until then...
strings.(아론의 말과 함께 그의 주위에 머물러 있던 어둠이 폭포수처럼 하늘로 솟: (At Aaron's words, the darkness around him surges skyward like a waterfall flowing in reverse.)
strings.(잠시 후, 글래스턴을 덮을 정도로 커진 불길한 어둠은 마치 세상의 종말: (It swells until it could cover all of Glaston, then crashes down as if heralding the end of the world.)
strings.(어디선가 들려오는 목소리와 함께 앞을 가로막았던 어둠이 증발하듯 사라진: (A voice reaches the adventurer, and the darkness before them dissolves into nothing.)
strings.아, 실피드 님…. 그런데 여기, …광장 북쪽 거리?: Oh, Sylphid... Wait, is this... the street north of the square?
Lux was right there in front of that gate...
Chirrr. There's no one there now.
strings.제가 쓰러진 %s 님 모시고 여기까지 왔어여. 괜찮아여? 괜찮은 거 맞져: I carried you all the way here after you collapsed, %s. Are you okay? You're really okay?
Chirp. Kid, tell them what happened before that too.
strings.찌르르. 정신 차려 보니 인간으로 위장했던 럭스는 없었다. 럭스가 데리고: Chirrr. When I came to, Lux and his human disguise were gone. The mage and skirmishers he'd brought along went back, with no idea why they'd come.
strings.찌르. 그리고 마법청사에서 일어난 일은 없던 게 됐다. 금서에서 흘러나온: Chirp. And everything that happened at the Magic Bureau has been erased. The forbidden tomes' magic never consumed the building. The tomes themselves never existed.
strings.사람들 아무것도 기억 못 해여. 아까 전만 해도 막 몬스터 피해서 도망다: Nobody remembers anything. Just a little while ago, they were all running from the monsters...
strings.왜 우리만 기억하는 거져?: Why are we the only ones who remember?
I'm sorry I can't explain everything, Letty.
strings.저에게 염력이 생긴 거랑 비슷한 거라고 생각하면 될까여?: Should I think of it as something like how I got my telekinesis?
strings.넹, 무슨 말씀인 줄 알았어여. 뭐, 나중에 알게 될 날이 오겠져. 비밀: Okay, I get it. Maybe someday I'll understand. It's a secret mission, so I'll keep the secret.
strings.찌르르. %s, 지금 상황은 다 그 마녀의 능력인 거지?: Chirrr. %s, this is all the work of that witch's power, isn't it?
strings.찌르. 럭스가 마녀와 함께 일을 꾸미는 거 아니었어?: Chirp. Wasn't Lux working with the witch?
I don't really know either, but perhaps...
Chirrr. I can hear the spirits in Glaston again. Let me find out what's going on.
strings.(실피드가 어디선가 들려오는 새의 지저귐에 집중하기 위해 눈을 감는다.): (Sylphid closes his eyes to focus on the birdsong reaching him.)
strings.찌르. 어. 어? 어…. 어? 어?: Chirp. Oh. Huh? Oh... What? What?
strings.찌르. 성안 병사들과 기사들이 너를 찾고 있는 것 같다. 네가 황제를 살: Chirp. The soldiers and knights in the castle seem to be looking for you. They say you tried to murder the empress.
strings.찌르르. 다른 일에 대한 거짓 기억이 덮어 씌워진 것 같다. 마법청과 관: Chirrr. It seems false memories of something else have been imposed on them. Every memory involving the Magic Bureau has vanished...
strings.(실피드의 말이 끝나자 %s의 주위에서 작은 빛이 일렁인다. 그리고 그: (As Sylphid finishes speaking, a small light flickers beside %s. Iris's urgent voice comes from within.)
strings.실피드 님. 빨리 협곡으로 돌아가세요. 마계의 문이 다시 연결되려고 하는: Sylphid. Return to the canyon immediately. I think the gate to the Demon Realm is about to reconnect.
strings.찌르. 네? 아, 네! 바로 가보겠습니다. %s, 미안하다. 나중에 보자: Chirp. What? Oh, yes! I'll go at once. Sorry, %s. I'll see you later.
strings.(실피드가 이리스의 말을 듣고 서둘러 하늘로 날아오른다.): (At Iris's words, Sylphid hurriedly takes flight.)
strings.%s, 어서 피해야 해요. 지금 여기서 방법을 찾고 있는데, 시간이 좀: %s, you need to get away. I'm trying to find a solution here, but it may take some time.
strings.안전한 곳이 있는데, 거기가 글래스턴에서 멀지 않은 곳에 있는 도로시 마: There's somewhere safe. Dorothy Village, not far from Glaston...
strings.(이야기를 이어가던 이리스의 목소리가 더는 들리지 않는다. 게다가 목소리: (Iris's voice cuts off. The light carrying it vanishes as well.)
Goddess, where did you go? Goddess? Oh, %s. The commander is coming.
strings.(아르젠트가 평소와는 다른 다급한 표정으로 서둘러 %s에게 다가온다.): (Argent hurries toward %s, looking far more urgent than usual.)
%s, I've been searching everywhere for you. You must hurry.
strings.뭐라 말씀드려야 될지 모르겠지만, 갑자기 저희 기사단을 제외한 모든 기사: I scarcely know how to explain this, but every order of knights and every company of soldiers except our own has suddenly begun pursuing you, %s.
strings.%s 님이 폐하를 위협할 리 없다는 걸 잘 알고 있습니다만, 그들은 진짜: I know you would never threaten Her Majesty, %s, but they truly believe you did.
strings.폐하께서 그런 일이 없다고 몇 번이고 오해라고 해명하고 계시지만, 의회의: Her Majesty has repeatedly insisted that nothing happened and that this is a misunderstanding. But the council nobles and other officials refuse to believe her.
strings.심지어 자신이 똑똑히 봤다는 목격자도 나와서 의회의 명으로 수배령이 떨어: Someone has even come forward claiming to have witnessed it. The council has issued a warrant for your arrest. You must get to safety.
strings.아론이 지시한 건가요? 지금 아론은 어디에 있죠?: Was this Aaron's order? Where is he now?
strings.지금 그가 어디 있고, 이 상황을 그가 지시했는지 아닌지까지는 확인할 수: I couldn't confirm his whereabouts or whether he ordered this. Please, escape first. We can decide what to do afterward...
strings.(그 순간, 광장 북쪽 거리로 기사들과 병사들의 몰려오는 발걸음 소리가: (Just then, the sound of approaching knights and soldiers fills the street north of the square.)
Her Majesty said you would be safe if you went to the Oscar Road. Hurry.
Escort %s to the Oscar Road while I hold them off. That is your mission.
strings.(아르젠트가 그 말과 함께 들고 있던 헬멧을 착용한다. 그리고 달려오는: (Argent puts on the helmet he was carrying and charges toward the approaching knights and soldiers.)
strings.%s 님, 안 돼여! 단장님이 어서 자리를 피하라고 했잖아여. 폐하 명도: No, %s! The commander told us to get out of here. It's Her Majesty's order too!
strings.드래곤 둥지에 들어가도 정신만 차리면 친구 먹을 수 있단 말 몰라여? 빨: Don't you know the saying? Keep your wits about you in a dragon's nest, and you might even make a friend! Now pull yourself together and follow me!
strings.빨리 가자구여!! 이러면 드래곤한테 잡아먹혀여!!: Let's go! At this rate, the dragon will eat us!
All right. Lead the way, Letty.
strings.(모험가는 병사들과 싸우는 아르젠트를 뒤로 한 채, 레티시아를 따라 좁은: (Leaving Argent fighting the soldiers, the adventurer follows Leticia into a narrow alley.)
strings.(한편, 행정지구 제일 높은 곳에서 모험가를 지켜보고 있던 토끼 귀 여인: (Meanwhile, a rabbit-eared woman watching from the highest point in the administrative district lets out a small sigh.)
Of all times, the empress sends you to the Oscar Road while the moon is waning. Even she could not have foreseen that...
Even if you meet the witch of Dorothy Village, you'll need luck on your side...
Hehe. All I can do is wish you good luck.
